setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step melody through a MIDI device: trigs on pattern degrees 1 to 4 of C major, so MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65 in the plain scale. The scale track is four steps long. Scale slot 2 (D major) is applied, slot 3 is E major (root up four semitones) and slot 4 is G major (root up seven). A global scale lock puts slot 4 on scale-track step 2, and a channel lock puts slot 3 on channel step 1. Scales lock until ptn end is On, its default, so the channel lock beats the global lock for the whole pattern. The MIDI strip reads 64, 66, 68, 69: E major.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC and turn Scales lock until ptn end Off. Return and Play. The channel lock now ends at the next trig that plays. Step 2 clears it, so steps 2 to 4 follow the global G-major lock: the strip reads MIDI 64, 69, 71 and 72.
